notes.title: *** Madness Fantasy BIG update IS OUT NOW!! + price cut!! ***
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128596/7e9cc0d6b450e426e94e0bf57b7cba4fa0c0190c.jpg

Here we go!
It's with immense pride that I announce that the first big expansion for Madness Fantasy is finally available! But wait!! To celebrate the event it's coming with a new unexpected price cut! You can now purchase MF for only 6.99$!! What are you waiting for?


Economic System 
A new economic system has been introduced that allows you to earn and spend MFMoney, the currency of the game! MFMoney can be earned in a variety of ways, from betting through mini-games to using certain types of gadgets, also introduced for the first time with this update!
Through MFMoney you can purchase aesthetic changes to the game and new gadgets, which will increase the variety of things to do in the city while in free mode.


Inventory 
An inventory has now been added to the game interface, a customizable system that can contain up to 6 gadgets at a time, which can be equipped in real time to quickly change your gameplay style within the strolls in city!


Minigames 
As you progress through the main story, several mini-games will be made available on the main map, allowing you to place bets and thus earn MFMoney!


Motels 
The motels available in the map have finally been activated, allowing you to quickly scroll the time in order to access the different types of favorite minigames (some of them are available only during the day, others only at night).


Extra updates 
Some minor bugs have been fixed and some pedestrian management systems have been revised.


What's next 
This first big update has laid the foundations for future expansions, which can now be implemented much easier and faster, but it's all up to you how much the world of MF can grow, so download the game, have fun and share your gaming experiences with friends or the community! Go wild with
Jackie, Max, Marv, Hank and Dex in this crazy adventure!

See you soon!

notes.title: *** Madness Fantasy BIG update announcement + 50% discount!! ***
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128596/7e9cc0d6b450e426e94e0bf57b7cba4fa0c0190c.jpg

It's official! 
A huge expansion for Madness Fantasy is coming in the next few weeks!! This expansion will revolutionize gameplay in free roaming sessions and also will going to considerably increase game replayability!

50% discount 
But before going into detail, remember that for a few days Madness Fantasy is available with a 50% discount!! Don't miss this incredible chance to have it half priced!!

Economic system 
An economic system will be introduced with the possibility of earning and spending money. Money can be earned in different ways, from betting through minigames to using certain types of gadgets, also introduced for the first time with this update.
The money earned can be spent in various ways, with collectibles and new gadgets that will be released over time, but also through the fencing of stolen vehicles and much more.

Inventory 
In the game interface, an inventory can be called up, a customizable system that will contain up to 5 gadgets at a time, which can be used in your strolls in the city.
These gadgets will allow you to make the free roaming experience very varied, adding depth and fun (did someone say there will be a "raimbow-shooter"?).
Gadgets, aesthetic changes and collectibles can be purchased with virtual money earned within the game in a special shop that will be created for the occasion!

Minigames 
As an implementation for the economic system, many minigames will be available in the city, where you can place bets and then win or lose money. Over time, new and ever new minigames will be released!

Motels 
The motels on the map will be "activated" to allow you to stay overnight and thus to pass time. This is because some minigames and situations will only be available at certain times of the day or night.

Minimap goals 
An option will be added to the game menu that will allow you to watch in real time on the minimap all the objectives currently in progress, whether they are from the main story, side missions or other, with relative description!

I will keep you updated in the coming weeks, in the meantime take advantage of this huge discount and start entering this crazy world of Madness Fantasy!

See ya!
